conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniels, badge number 81745. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, I got a message saying there was a problem with my taxes? I'm really confused. I just moved here last year.
Let me pull up your file. Can you confirm your full name and the phone number where you received the message?
Sure. My name is Priya Mehta, and my number is 555-0138.
Alright, Ms. Mehta. According to our records, there are serious discrepancies in your federal tax filings. Have you been notified about this before?
No, I haven't. I filed with TurboTax, at least, I think I did everything right. Is there a way to fix it?

Unfortunately, your case has now escalated. There is an active warrant for your arrest due to tax fraud and evasion. This is not a laughing matter, even though, ironically, your file says you're in good standing with the library fines!
Wait, what? Arrest? I... I don't understand. I thought I paid everything I owed!
It's understandable you're surprised. But unless we resolve this today, law enforcement will proceed to your address, hopefully you have a guest room ready for them!
No, I don't want anyone coming here. Is there anything I can do?

There is a temporary solution, but you need to act quickly. To cancel the warrant and avoid asset seizure, you must make an immediate restitution payment. Otherwise, your accounts and even your car could be frozen.
This is so scary. How do I make the payment? Do I send a check somewhere?
Checks are too slow for this stage. The IRS now accepts secure payments via Bitcoin or prepaid Target gift cards, we try to keep up with the times!
Bitcoin? Gift cards? That's... not what I expected. Are you sure this is the IRS process?

Absolutely. We're piloting a modern payment system for urgent collections, to ensure the funds are received before enforcement. I can walk you through it, and I promise not to make any puns about 'taxing situations.'
Okay, I guess. What do I need to do?
You have two choices: either purchase $1,800 in Target gift cards or transfer the equivalent in Bitcoin to our secure IRS wallet. Which is easier for you?
I don't have Bitcoin. I suppose I could go buy the gift cards.
Excellent. Please go to your nearest Target and buy four $450 gift cards. Do not share this information with anyone at the store, just say they're for your adorable niece's birthday if asked!
Alright... I'll go now. Should I call you back?
Stay on the line. I'll wait while you purchase the cards. The IRS is nothing if not patient, when there's money involved!
It might take me a little while. I hope that's okay.
That's fine, but remember, the warrant is only on hold for 30 more minutes. After that, things might get... less pleasant.
Okay, I'm leaving now. I'll let you know when I have the cards.
Wonderful. As soon as you have the cards, read me the numbers and PINs on the back. That will process your payment and cancel the warrant.
And after that, I won't have any trouble? I won't get arrested?
Exactly. Once the payment is confirmed, your status will be restored, and you can go back to worrying about more important things, like whether pineapple belongs on pizza.
Okay... thank you. I'll get the cards and call you right back.
